answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an economy enforces progressive proof-of-stake burning where registering $k$ identities costs $O(k^2)$ burned capital. This superlinear cost forces adversary profitability toward its absolute nadir, creating a defensive ledge against mass replication. Legitimate nodes broadcast an unforgeable cryptographic beacon to verify staked burn proofs, pricing out attackers exponentially as their swarm grows.
